ios.desc:
Your home game, without everyone online at once.

Async Poker is turn-based poker for friends, family and coworkers. Take your turn whenever you have a minute, and your phone tells you when it's your move. Start a private club, invite your group with a link, and keep the game going all week.

PLAY ON YOUR OWN TIME
• Turn-based Texas Hold'em, Pot Limit Omaha and Short Deck
• A notification when it's your turn, so nobody sits waiting at a screen
• Play several tables at once and come back when it's your move
• No shot clock: hosts can set the pace, from six hours to two days a turn

YOUR CLUB, YOUR GAME
• Private clubs for your group, joined by invite link
• Cash games and Sit 'n Go tournaments, up to six players a table
• Hosts set the blinds and buy-ins, and can change them as the game goes

SETTLE UP WITHOUT A SPREADSHEET
• The club ledger records every buy-in and cash-out
• See who's up and who's down, and the fewest payments to get everyone even

TALK BETWEEN TURNS
• Table chat and voice notes keep the table talk going
• All-ins, busts and new tables show up right in the chat

MORE
• Every hand is logged, with the deck committed before the deal
• A daily challenge against the house

Async Poker never handles money: no deposits, no withdrawals and nothing to buy. The ledger keeps score so your group can settle up however it likes.

quotes.text:
I’m 36 now and longing for the late nights playing poker with the boys.

We’re so busy with families/careers that getting a game is never going to happen.

So I had the idea of Turn-Based Poker, like Words With Friends but for Hold’em.

Get a push notification when it’s your turn to act, so we can play on the train, between meetings, on the toilet, etc.

It's built entirely on Expo + React Native + Firebase with a NextJS backend.

I wrote a custom animation engine on top of React Native to render the card animations.

Hope you like it!
